name: Chomsky
author: alhasapi
description: Unified manager for a Dusky-derived look & feel: animation presets, screen shaders, border-resize/dim window behavior, monitor rotation, wallpaper cycling, and a switch between Omarchy's keybindings and Dusky's -- all bundled, no other config edits required. Driven from its own rows in the Omarchy menu, so the bar chip is optional.

barWidget.description: Animations, shaders, window behavior, keybindings, monitor rotation, and wallpapers in one panel

schema.label: Omarchy menu rows
schema.description: Add Style > Animation / Shader / Window Behavior / Display / Wallpaper rows for this plugin to the Omarchy menu. Removed from the menu when this is off.

schema.label: Default dim strength
schema.description: Inactive-window dim applied when Window behavior is first turned on
